C1272.title: SSO Authentication Flaw Leading to Arbitrary User Login
C1272.summary: A mobile app's SSO flow had a flaw where the sub-application did not properly use the SSO-issued credentials, instead building its own encrypted authentication system. By reverse-engineering the JavaScript encryption, an attacker could obtain parameters like user phone numbers and craft requests to bypass authentication, enabling arbitrary user login and access to sensitive data such as order reco
